servicesTitle: Inside, outside, and built to last.
servicesIntro: Pick what your car needs, from a deep interior clean to long-term protection against Florida sun and lovebugs.

services.name: Lifetime Ceramic Coatings
services.text: A coating that bonds to your paint for extreme gloss, hydrophobic performance and easier washing.

services.name: Paint Correction
services.text: Multi-stage polishing that removes swirl marks, oxidation and fine scratches.

services.name: Paint Protection Film
services.text: A nearly invisible, self-healing layer that shields paint from rock chips and road debris.

services.name: Interior Car Detailing
services.text: Deep-cleaned carpets and upholstery, sanitized touch points, conditioned leather and restored trim.

services.name: Exterior Car Detailing
services.text: Deep wheel cleaning, paint decontamination and protective treatments for a deeper gloss.

services.name: Monthly Maintenance Wash
services.text: Safe washes and interior refreshes that keep a detailed or coated car looking sharp.
